items.title: Ash Bloom
items.alt: Black cotton cloth with cream bleached blooms scattered across it
items.description: Colour is taken out of black cloth rather than put in — each bloom is drawn by where the discharge paste is allowed to spread.

items.title: Night Garden
items.alt: Dark cloth with pale, leaf-like discharge marks rising like a thicket
items.description: Layered marks build a dense, plant-like silhouette against a black ground, lighter and warmer where the cloth has opened up.

items.title: Garden Folio
items.alt: A densely drawn sheet of flowers, leaves, birds and paisley shapes in many colours
items.description: A full sheet of hand-drawn motifs — florals, foliage and birds — made as a source library for repeats and placement prints.

items.title: Indigo Tide
items.alt: A length of cloth dyed in bands of deep indigo and white with soft, bleeding edges
items.description: Folded, bound and dipped: the resist leaves white bands that bleed softly into indigo along the length of the cloth.

items.title: Flame Stripe
items.alt: A handwoven mat in blue, orange and white stripes with a flame-like band of inlaid threads
items.description: A striped hand-woven mat interrupted by one band of inlaid, flame-coloured threads left to stand proud of the surface.

items.title: Ember Line
items.alt: Near-black cloth with a single pale trail edged in yellow running down one side
items.description: A quieter study: one trailing line, haloed in yellow where the dye breaks, set against a field of small scattered marks.

items.title: Thread Wall
items.alt: An exhibition wall with a tufted purple frame, hanging threads and woven stools
items.description: A room-sized piece: tufted panels, a curtain of loose threads and woven seating, shown together as one installation.

items.title: Printed Kurta
items.alt: A mannequin wearing a printed kurta with white trousers, with pattern swatches pinned behind
items.description: A repeat print developed from swatch to garment, shown with the pattern studies that led to it.

items.title: Match Day
items.alt: A T-shirt with a bold red graphic print on a mannequin, beside the poster studies for the print
items.description: A sport-inspired graphic series, taken from poster studies through to a placement print on jersey.

items.title: Halo
items.alt: Tie-dyed cloth with dark radiating rings on a sandy gold ground
items.description: Bound and discharged in rings, the cloth keeps the memory of every tie as a dark, radiating halo.
